items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: the title Evidence was (a) the title of a Monk tune

ctx.x: Sun Ra. It’s a very diverse list. What — was there one or two things that had to be happening in the music for it to appear on Evidence Records?

It had to be available and I had to like it. That’s the best way I can put it. And I mean the goals of Evidence changed throughout the years. Initially the title Evidence came from I had planned on issuing re-issuing out-of-print records. Remember I told you the customers would say, “Out of print? What kind of out of print? I want it. Where is it?” And so it had become my goal initially, once I had sold my record store, to put out re- issues. So that’s how it started and the title Evidence was (a) the title of a…
